caption: The drawing features a series of abstract, organic shapes primarily colored in shades of blue, arranged horizontally across the upper middle section of the image. The shapes vary in size, appearing bulbous and elongated, with some overlapping or joined together, and are set against a beige background with scattered, small reddish-brown specks. At the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a simple outline of a vase in blue, with a few of the same blue organic shapes depicted as a decorative motif on its upper section. The overall composition is horizontal, with the organic forms creating a flowing line across the page and the outlined vase as a secondary, smaller element. The artist's signature, "John Tarantino," is visible in the lower left portion of the image.
title: Crock
